Message:
ALSA: hda/realtek: Add quirk for mute LEDs on HP ENVY x360 15-eu0xxx

The LED for the mic mute button is controlled by GPIO2.
The mute button LED is slightly more complex, it's controlled by two bits
in coeff 0x0b.
